current_date: Last updated March 2024; a revised list (Appendix A) was recommended for Council adoption by the Executive on 28 May 2026
current_evidence: Pendle's 'Planning application checklists' page (downloads/download/3208) lists 16 checklists, one per application type, with 'Full Planning Applications checklist - including Biodiversity Net Gain validation' as the main list. The Executive report of 28 May 2026 (meetings id 31867) says the validation list 'was last updated in March 2024' and recommends that the Council adopt a revised Full Application Planning Checklist (Appendix A, meetings id 31868). Whether full Council adopted it, and whether file 11878 is the 2026 version, could not be confirmed because the fetch and search budgets ran out.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link is the Outline Planning Applications checklist, one of 16 checklists for specific application types, not Pendle's local validation list. Grokbot read only this document, so every other application type shows '(none)'. Pendle publishes separate checklists for Householder, Full (including BNG), Reserved Matters, Listed Building Consent, Advertisement Consent, Conservation Area demolition, CLEUD/CLOPUD, Section 73, Removal/Variation of condition, Non-Material Amendment, Telecommunications, Agricultural prior notification, Hedgerow removal and Tree works.
issues.evidence: Planning application checklists page lists 'Full Planning Applications checklist - including Biodiversity Net Gain validation' (file 11878), 'Householder Applications checklist' (11863), 'Listed Building Consent checklist' (11864) and others, alongside 'Outline Planning Applications checklist' (11868).

issues.detail: The outline checklist's guidance text Grokbot extracted relies on long-superseded policy: PPS23 (2004) for contamination, PPG13 (2001) for transport, Use Class A3 (abolished 2020) for ventilation, DTI 2004 Site Waste Management Plans and ODPM/DfT 2002 travel plan guidance. The current Full checklist, updated March 2024 and revised again in 2026, uses current triggers.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts: 'Planning Policy Statement 23 ... (November 2004)'; 'Planning Policy Guidance 13 'Transport' (March 2001)'; 'Use Classes A3'.

issues.detail: The List date of 2023-10-01 comes from PDF metadata, not the document. The council's own report says the validation list was last updated in March 2024, and a revised list was recommended for adoption on 28 May 2026. None of the checklists on the download page shows a date.
issues.evidence: Executive report 28 May 2026: the current version 'was last updated in March 2024'; 'Recommend that the Council adopts the Validation List as set out at Appendix A'.

issues.detail: The current Full Application checklist has local requirements that Grokbot did not capture at all. Ball Strike Assessment (new in 2026): development that could produce balls, such as golf or cricket, or development near such venues. Coal Mining Assessment: ground disturbance in a Coal Authority high-risk area. Construction Method Statement: where construction could affect neighbours (deliveries, hours, limited space, mud on roads). Marketing and Viability Report: change of use or redevelopment where the existing use is claimed unviable and policy requires its retention. Preliminary Ecological Appraisal and Protected Species/bat surveys: development on or near ecological sites, demolition, barn conversions, works to older buildings or roof spaces, and removal of trees, hedgerows, scrub or water features. Pre-commencement conditions: where full details are not available at application stage. Topographical survey: normally for major development, or where levels are important to the design. Biodiversity Net Gain: statutory 10% with Tables 1-3 of required documents and listed exemptions. Fire Statement: buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation. Parking and Access Arrangements: proposals that increase parking demand, requiring a site layout plan.
issues.evidence: Pendle Executive 28 May 2026 Appendix A 'Full Application Planning Checklist', Local Information Requirements; the report notes the new ball strike requirement 'on page 16'.

issues.detail: Several triggers do not match the current list. Heritage Statement is limited to Areas of Archaeological Potential and major development, but the current trigger is development in, adjacent to or close to a conservation area or listed building, or affecting archaeology or other heritage assets. Drainage reads 'Drainage details that will achieve Building Regulations Approval', but the current trigger is major development, or surface-water drainage in Flood Zone 2/3 or areas at surface-water flood risk, with SuDS on the LCC pro-forma for all majors. The FRA wording is generic, while the current list names Flood Zones 2/3/3b, Flood Zone 1 sites of 1 ha+, critical drainage areas, SFRA increased-risk areas and changes in vulnerability. Noise is now required for all B2 applications and for noise-sensitive development near major noise sources. Air Quality now names North Valley, A682 Brierfield and A682 Barrowford. Land contamination now covers sites within 250m of a landfill and sensitive end uses. Planning Statement is now required for major development, 1+ dwellings, residential change of use, commercial over 1,000 sqm, non-agricultural development on agricultural land and Traveller sites.
issues.evidence: Appendix A: FRA 'flood zones 2, 3, or 3b; flood zone 1 with a site area of 1 hectare or more; critical drainage ...'; Heritage Statement 'in, adjacent to, or close to a conservation area, or to or close to a listed building'.

issues.detail: Several excerpts are fragments or text from another item. 'Housing mix / dwelling standards (NDSS)' quotes only 'Document "Greenspace Standards and New Development"', which is open-space guidance, not dwelling standards. The Travel Plan excerpt runs into the Tree Survey text. 'Retail / Town Centre ... Sequential test' reads only 'other main town centre uses located within the town centre.' 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes checklist questions about a method statement, boundary treatments and materials, and is not a listed-building schedule of works. 'Parking provision' reads only 'and proposed parking provision and access arrangements.'
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts as listed in the Outline app_type_rows.

issues.detail: All 33 requirements sit under 'Outline', while Full planning, Householder, Reserved matters, Listed building consent and the other types are marked '(none)'. The Full Application checklist is Pendle's main local list. It applies to full applications, including changes of use, minor and major, and most of the same requirements apply to Householder, Reserved Matters and LBC through their own checklists.
issues.evidence: Appendix A scope: 'Full planning applications, including change of use, minor and major'.

issues.detail: 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' repeats the 'Daylight / Sunlight / Overshadowing Assessment' row using the end of the same sentence. 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' and 'Ecological Survey' both come from the single biodiversity survey item; no separate questionnaire is required.
issues.evidence: 'gardens or amenity space then applications may also need to be accompanied by a daylight/sunlight assessment.'

issues.detail: 'Photographs / Photomontages' is advisory text ('These provide useful background information'), not a validation requirement. The drawing-standards tab item also contains the separate ownership-certificate and encroachment note. The 'Employment / Economic Statement' excerpt says such statements 'will be beneficial', which is advice, while the current trigger is loss of protected employment land or development justified by economic benefit.
issues.evidence: 'PHOTOGRAPHS AND PHOTOMONTAGES These provide useful background information ...'; 'CERTIFICATES AND ENCROACHMENT ONTO ADJOINING PROPERTY ...'.

summary: Grokbot captured only Pendle's Outline application checklist, which uses 2001-2004 era guidance and a PDF-metadata date, instead of the Full Planning Applications checklist (updated March 2024, with a revised version recommended for adoption in May 2026). As a result it misses requirements such as Ball Strike, Coal Mining, Construction Method Statement, PEA/bat surveys and BNG, and shows '(none)' for every application type except Outline.
